title: Motorcycle Hand Warmers – Windproof Grip Covers
descriptionHtml:
Keep your hands warm on the ride

Cold hands on the motorcycle or snowmobile make the ride both uncomfortable and unsafe. Thin gloves are rarely enough when a cold wind is blowing.

Windproof covers right on the handlebars

These hand warmers slide onto the handlebars and protect your hands from wind and cold. They have a zippered pocket and fit most motorcycles and snowmobiles.

Features

  • Windproof and warming
  • Slide easily onto the handlebars
  • With a handy zippered pocket
  • One size fits most
  • Great for motorcycles, mopeds and snowmobiles

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
